## Problem / motivation

Is your feature request related to a problem? A clear description of what the
problem is. E.g. "I'm frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Design fit

How does this fit the project's design law (umber/dust/oxblood signals, no
green/neon/gradient, serif titles)? Mockups welcome.

## Additional context

Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
